definitions.explanation: Noticeably different from the norm in a way that seems strange or quirky. Can describe people, things, or ideas.

examples.japanese: {風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
{風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a restaurant with an unusual name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていて→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: He has an unusual hobby — he collects old maps.

notes:
Literally means "changed in style/manner" ({風|ふう} = style/manner + {変|か}わり = changed). Describes something that deviates from the norm, but without the strongly negative connotation that "strange" or "weird" might carry. Often implies mild curiosity or amusement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an eccentric person
- {風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧: an unusual hobby
- {風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: an unconventional building
- {風変|ふうが}わりな⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧: an unconventional idea

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧: strange, odd — more blunt, can be negative
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧: unique, distinctive — more neutral or positive
- ⟦{奇妙|きみょう}→奇妙：01630_kimyou⟧: bizarre, peculiar — stronger sense of strangeness
- ⟦ユニーク→ユニーク：11393_yuniiku⟧: unique — loanword, generally positive
